title: Octave Hop Boutique
prompt: dance pop in the style of the band big sis
description: Punchy LinnDrum kicks and claps frame an octave-hopping square-wave bass that bounces between C2 and C3, giving the track its springy, playful energy. Upper-register square chords chop on the offbeats in the chorus while a pentatonic triangle melody dances above, occasionally doubled an octave up.
code:
setcpm(112/4)
arrange(
  [16, stack(
    s("bd ~ ~ bd ~ ~ bd ~").bank("LinnDrum").gain(0.85),
    s("[~ hh]*4").bank("LinnDrum").gain(0.55).pan(sine.range(0.35, 0.65)).cut(1),
    note("<c2 c3 eb2 c3 g1 g2 bb1 c2>*8").s("square").lpf(sine.slow(8).range(300, 900)).resonance(8).decay(0.14).sustain(0).gain(0.8)
  )],
  [24, stack(
    s("bd*4").bank("LinnDrum").gain(0.9),
    s("[~ hh]*4").bank("LinnDrum").gain(0.6).pan(sine.range(0.35, 0.65)).cut(1),
    s("~ cp ~ cp").bank("LinnDrum").room(0.25).gain(0.6),
    note("<c2 c3 eb2 c3 g1 g2 bb1 c2>*8").s("square").lpf(saw.slow(16).range(400, 1600)).resonance(10).decay(0.13).sustain(0).gain(0.85),
    note("<[eb4,g4,c5] [d4,f4,bb4]>").s("square").struct("~ x ~ x ~ x ~ x").decay(0.12).sustain(0).lpf(2200).gain(0.5).room(0.2)
  )],
  [28, stack(
    s("bd*4").bank("LinnDrum").gain(0.95),
    s("[~ hh]*4").bank("LinnDrum").gain(0.62).pan(sine.range(0.35, 0.65)).cut(1),
    s("~ cp ~ cp").bank("LinnDrum").room(0.3).gain(0.65),
    s("~ ~ ~ oh").bank("LinnDrum").gain(0.4).cut(1),
    note("<c2 c3 eb2 c3 g1 g2 bb1 c2>*8").s("square").lpf(1800).resonance(11).decay(0.13).sustain(0).gain(0.9).every(4, x => x.ply(2)),
    note("<[eb4,g4,c5] [d4,f4,bb4] [g4,bb4,eb5] [d4,f4,bb4]>").s("square").struct("~ x ~ x ~ x ~ x").decay(0.11).sustain(0).lpf(2600).gain(0.55).room(0.25).delay(0.2),
    n("0 2 4 7 4 2").scale("C4:minor:pentatonic").s("triangle").decay(0.2).sustain(0).gain(0.45).room(0.3).pan(0.65)
  )],
  [16, stack(
    note("<c2 c3 eb2 c3 g1 g2 bb1 c2>*8").s("square").lpf(sine.slow(8).range(350, 1200)).resonance(9).decay(0.16).sustain(0).gain(0.7),
    note("<[eb4,g4,c5] [ab3,c4,eb4]>").s("triangle").decay(0.4).sustain(0.3).release(0.3).lpf(1400).gain(0.5).room(0.5),
    s("[~ hh]*2").bank("LinnDrum").gain(0.45).cut(1).degradeBy(0.3)
  )],
  [28, stack(
    s("bd*4").bank("LinnDrum").gain(0.98),
    s("[hh hh]*4").bank("LinnDrum").gain(0.6).pan(sine.range(0.3, 0.7)).cut(1).degradeBy(0.15),
    s("~ cp ~ cp").bank("LinnDrum").room(0.3).gain(0.68),
    s("~ ~ oh ~").bank("LinnDrum").gain(0.42).cut(1),
    note("<c2 c3 eb2 c3 g1 g2 bb1 c2>*8").s("square").lpf(2000).resonance(12).decay(0.12).sustain(0).gain(0.92).every(8, x => x.rev()),
    note("<[eb4,g4,c5] [d4,f4,bb4] [g4,bb4,eb5] [f4,ab4,c5]>").s("square").struct("~ x ~ x ~ x ~ x").decay(0.1).sustain(0).lpf(3000).gain(0.58).room(0.25).delay(0.18),
    n("0 2 4 7 9 7 4 2").scale("C4:minor:pentatonic").s("triangle").decay(0.18).sustain(0).gain(0.48).room(0.3).pan(sine.range(0.4, 0.6)).off(0.125, x => x.add(note(12)).gain(0.3))
  )],
  [16, stack(
    s("bd ~ ~ bd ~ ~ bd ~").bank("LinnDrum").gain(0.82),
    s("[~ hh]*4").bank("LinnDrum").gain(0.5).pan(sine.range(0.4, 0.6)).cut(1).degradeBy(0.2),
    note("<c2 c3 eb2 c3 g1 g2 bb1 c2>*8").s("square").lpf(sine.slow(8).range(300, 800)).resonance(7).decay(0.15).sustain(0).gain(0.72),
    note("<[eb4,g4,c5] [ab3,c4,eb4]>").s("triangle").decay(0.4).sustain(0.2).release(0.4).lpf(1200).gain(0.42).room(0.5)
  )]
)
